title: Aoyagi Toya — Your Stomach Doesn't Lie〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, Toya, I think you just received a message.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, KAITO.
I'll take a look.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sounded like the notification for a messaging app just now, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Haha. Want me to do it too?
I can let you know when you get a message or when it's morning and stuff!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks, but I kinda doubt you'll like doing morning calls. We have to wake up at five when we have morning practices.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<What?! That's so early!
On second thought, I think I'll pass.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, I heard from Azusawa that she's okay with our schedule change for tomorrow's practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, this one's from Shiraishi...
She seems okay with it as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's start practice earlier than scheduled like we told them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Nice! You guys sound totally pumped!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, they do. Is it because you were with that Tono person and his friend just earlier?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I really wasn't expecting to meet his partner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me neither. He originally said that he was somewhere far away, so I didn't think we'd ever meet him...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You're Shinonome and Aoyagi, right?
He's told me all about you guys!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
I'm Soma Miyata.
This dude's best friend!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Does being allowed to transfer hospitals mean his recovery's going well?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hearing their story reminded me of just how incredible Tono is. I mean, he's carrying Soma's dream along with his own.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still have trouble figuring out what Tono's thinking...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But he's trying to surpass that night and no one can match his resolve. It almost hurt to see his determination the first the I met him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And that resolve is what allows him to put on such astounding performances.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That story really made me think after I heard it...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I mean, if something happened that kept me from singing with Rin, I'm not sure I could keep going while carrying her thoughts with me.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Just thinking about it is tough...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
That's why I think it's incredible how someone can carry their dear friend's dream like that.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since I... Like Tono, I also received my dream from my “partner”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I suppose the only one who can carry a partner's dream is that very person's partner, no...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <However, Toya, you and the others are also chasing after the same dream. Doesn't that put you all in the same boat?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Which means Tono isn't alone anymore, right?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I certainly hope that's true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, we don't know how they feel about that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Haha! I'm sure you guys are gonna be fine!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <They even seemed a little relieved when talking to you guys just now, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I agree. I'm looking forward to seeing how your event goes.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Wait, we gotta go!
We still have our own event to prepare for!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, you're right. MEIKO and Miku might get mad if we stay away for too long.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We'll see you later, Toya, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, see you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's head home and get in some rest before practice tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's make sure our event succeeds.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We will, dude, so let's go home already.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.
